title: 第6章 加码加价
slug: 七天后穿越我提前囤货躲灾年
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

“不放过我？那你倒是给我说说，怎么个不放过法？”

“是打算坏我工作断我生计，还是打算禁锢行踪限我自由？你是嫁了人，不是成了神，瞧把你给能耐的。”

见谭筝压根不把自己放在眼里，王大丫更生气了。

“还有，对你这样的人，不能太给脸了，越是隐忍，你蹦跶得就越厉害。”

“我用最真实，最不绕，最直接的方式跟你讲——马上还钱！”

“只还一万可不够哦，得加些利息，而且我这还有你整容前的丑照，你也不想被更多人看到吧？尤其是你老公。”

整容前的照片，王大丫自己都删了个精光，没想到谭筝那还有。

一想到自己伏低做小了那么久，才有了名分，她绝对不能在这个节骨眼上出任何岔子。

王大丫深呼吸了几下，咬牙道：“好，我给你转两万，可以了吧？”

谭筝微微皱眉，显然是对这个价格不太满意。

她点开手机屏幕，划拉到一张照片，感慨道：

“这不是你和你初恋的合照吗？那时候瞧着真青涩啊，这么多年过去，也不知道你们还有没有联系。”

王大丫捏紧了拳头，上调了价格：“三万，三万行了吧？！你快闭嘴！”

谭筝这下是真的有些可怜王大丫了，都要嫁给有钱人当阔太了，手里怎么连点现钱都没有。

或许是她的嫌弃的目光太过明显，王大丫也有些尴尬。

“家里的账单都是我老公在付，偶尔购物也是他直接刷卡，他只给了我一些零花钱，让我拿去跟小姐妹们喝茶聊天，一口气花太多，他会怀疑的。”

合着她老公对她也没多放心，把钱都捏得死死的。

谭筝略微思索了一下，伸出手比了个数字。

“五万，你给我转五万块，我立马把你丑照给删了。”

“五万……”

对方没有马上拒绝，谭筝就知道这事有戏！

“当初要是没有我们这些朋友，你哪来的钱去整容？又怎么会嫁给你现在的老公？四舍五入，我还是你和你老公的红娘呢。”

王大丫嘴角抽了抽，还可以这么四舍五入的吗？

“五万块，买断你的丑照，买断我的捣乱，很划算的！你要是实在不肯，那我只好去找你老公要这个钱了。”

说罢，谭筝作势要走，王大丫赶忙上前拉住。

“别去！我给！我给你这钱还不行嘛！”

耶斯！又赚一笔！

content_en:
Page (1/3)

"Don't let me go? Then tell me, why don't you let me go?"

"Are you planning to ruin my job and my livelihood, or are you planning to confine my whereabouts and restrict my freedom? You are married, not a god. Let's see what you can do."

Seeing that Tan Zheng didn't take her seriously at all, Wang Daya became even more angry.

"Also, I can't be too disrespectful to people like you. The more you tolerate it, the harder you will jump."

“I’m telling you in the most truthful, straightforward and direct way – pay back the money immediately!”

"Just paying back 10,000 yuan is not enough, you have to add some interest, and I also have ugly photos of you before plastic surgery. You don't want more people to see it, right? Especially your husband."

Wang Daya himself had deleted all the photos before plastic surgery, but she didn't expect that Tan Zheng still had them.

When she thought about how she had been a child for so long before she got her status, she absolutely couldn't make any mistakes at this juncture.

Wang Daya took a few deep breaths, gritted his teeth and said, "Okay, I'll transfer 20,000 to you, is that okay?"

Tan Zheng frowned slightly, obviously not satisfied with the price.

She clicked on the screen of her phone, scrolled down to a photo, and said with emotion:

"Isn't this a photo of you and your first love? You looked so young back then. After so many years, I don't know if you still have contact."

Wang Daya clenched her fists and raised the price: "Thirty thousand, thirty thousand is enough?! Shut up!"

Tan Zheng really felt pity for Wang Daya now. She wanted to marry a rich man and become a rich lady, but she didn't even have any cash in her hand.

Perhaps her look of disgust was too obvious, and Wang Daya was also a little embarrassed.

"My husband pays all the bills at home, and occasionally he swipes his credit card directly for shopping. He only gives me some pocket money to drink tea and chat with my little sisters. If I spend too much in one go, he will be suspicious."

At the same time, her husband didn't trust her much and was very worried about the money.

Tan Zheng thought for a moment, stretched out his hand and compared the numbers.

"Fifty thousand, you transfer me fifty thousand, and I will delete your ugly photos immediately."

"Fifty thousand..."

When the other party didn't refuse immediately, Tan Zheng knew there was something serious about it!

"If you didn't have friends like us, where would you have the money to have plastic surgery? How could you marry your current husband? After all, I am still the matchmaker for you and your husband."

Wang Daya's mouth twitched, could she still round up like this?

"Fifty thousand yuan is a bargain to buy out your ugly photos and my troubles! If you really refuse, then I will have to go to your husband to ask for the money."

After that, Tan Zheng made a move to leave, but Wang Daya hurriedly stepped forward to hold him back.

"Don't go! I'll give it! Why don't I give you this money!"

Yes!Make another profit!
